title: ceammc.proto
description: `ceammc.proto` is a collection of protocol-related objects in the `ceammc` library, covering MIDI and SysEx processing, hardware control, media-player control, encoding, and decoding. The help patch serves as an index linking to specific objects such as `proto.midi`, `proto.firmata`, `proto.vlc`, and `proto.ltc.in~` rather than documenting a standalone `ceammc.proto` object.
